company.name: Brainboard
company.shortDescription: Brainboard is a software company that provides engineers with end-to-end tools for managing and visually designing Cloud infrastructures.
company.description: Brainboard is an AI driven platform to visually design and manage cloud infrastructure, collaboratively. It's the only solution that automatically generates IaC code for any cloud provider, with an embedded CI/CD.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud infrastructure design and management platform that visually creates and manages infrastructure as code (IaC) with automatic Terraform/OpenTofu code generation and embedded CI/CD.
productsAndServices.name: Brainboard Platform

productsAndServices.description: A visual design tool within Brainboard that allows users to create cloud infrastructure diagrams which automatically generate corresponding Terraform code.
productsAndServices.name: Smart Cloud Designer

productsAndServices.description: A centralized repository within Brainboard for managing private, public, and community Terraform and OpenTofu modules as a single source of truth.
productsAndServices.name: Terraform & OpenTofu Modules Management

productsAndServices.description: A feature that connects cloud infrastructure code with Git repositories to enable continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) workflows.
productsAndServices.name: GitOps Workflow Integration

productsAndServices.description: A monitoring feature that detects and corrects discrepancies between the declared infrastructure code and the actual cloud environment.
productsAndServices.name: Drift Detection and Remediation

productsAndServices.description: A capability to maintain consistency and eliminate drift across multiple cloud environments such as development, QA, staging, and production.
productsAndServices.name: Synchronized Architectures
